verdict.rationale: LangSmith's evaluation docs say you can run evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions. Each run creates a dataset-backed experiment, and pairwise-comparison evaluators and trace comparison via UI/API are also documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a side-by-side experiment comparison view with regression highlighting, per-example diffing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
